the fragment states the bounded-pass suite passes at head (6 passed) but the manifest's test_logs carry no log for that suite; the run exists only in the reviewed run's stream.jsonl, so a later reader holding just the manifest and its logs cannot check the claim.

this source change and the test file it relies on sit outside the only write paths the run declared (the evidence fragment and the figure directory); the node's write_paths is empty and the manifest explains the narrow grant, but the record read alone says the landed code was fenced to documentation.
